title: PWM Write
text: Send pulse width modulation (PWM) signal configuration to PWM Interface block, 3 inputs, 1 output; {Show period as input} shows period input port and {Show phase as input} shows phase input port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Compare
ports.summary: Comparator trigger value positive scalar | N -length positive vector

ports.name: Period
ports.summary: Period of PWM waveform positive scalar

ports.name: Phase
ports.summary: Phase offset of the waveform scalar from 0 to PWM period

params.name: Show period as input
params.values: Show period input port off (default) | on

params.name: Show phase as input
params.values: Show phase input port off (default) | on
